market_trends_2025_2026: CISA 2026 SBOM Minimum Elements (final, 30 Jul 2026; co-sealed by NSA, FBI and 15 international agencies) supersede NTIA 2021: adds component hash and algorithm, licence, tool name/version, generation context, SBOM version and author signature; requires full transitive coverage; only SPDX and CycloneDX are accepted (SWID dropped). Draft was published Aug 2025 for comment.

EU Cyber Resilience Act: reporting obligations for actively exploited vulnerabilities and severe incidents apply from 11 Sep 2026; full obligations (including SBOM in technical documentation) from 11 Dec 2027. Vendors (Cybeats, FOSSA, Sonatype, Black Duck, Mend, Anchore) now ship CRA mappings.

CycloneDX 1.7 (21 Oct 2025) ratified as ECMA-424 2nd edition (Dec 2025): CBOM crypto families, patents, citations for provenance. Tooling catch-up: cdxgen, CycloneDX CLI and Cybeats support 1.7; Dependency-Track 4.14.4/5.x ingest 1.7; Trivy, Snyk and GitLab still emit 1.5/1.6.

SPDX 3.0.1 is the current SPDX release with AI and Dataset profiles; ISO/IEC 5962 revision for SPDX 3.0 is at DIS stage (voting closed 9 Jun 2026). Generator support for SPDX 3.x remains thin (Microsoft sbom-tool, cdxgen conversion, Cybeats); spdx-sbom-generator was archived Jan 2025.

AI BOM standardisation: CycloneDX ML-BOM (1.5+) and SPDX 3.0.1 AI/Dataset profiles both exist, but vendors mostly export proprietary inventories; only cdxgen, Snyk aibom, OWASP AIBOM Generator, ZeroPath and agent-bom were verified to emit CycloneDX. No ratified schema for agents, prompts or MCP servers yet (CycloneDX issue #895 closed; Agent Control Standard from OWASP is a governance spec, not a BOM schema). CISA flagged AI systems as a future minimum-elements area.

VEX adoption is uneven: CycloneDX VEX is the de facto exchange in Dependency-Track, Sonatype, Cybeats and Black Duck; OpenVEX dominates OSS scanners (Trivy, Grype, GUAC); CSAF VEX remains rare outside device manufacturers. CISA 2026 lists VEX/CSAF integration as a future work area.

Consolidation in model scanning: Protect AI into Palo Alto Networks Prisma AIRS (completed 22 Jul 2025); Prompt Security into SentinelOne (announced 5 Aug 2025); Aim Security into Cisco AI Defense (announced 2025, completion details unverified). HiddenLayer ($100M Series B), Noma ($100M Series B, Jul 2025), Oligo ($60M, Aug 2026) and AIR ($50M seed, Sep 2026) show continued funding for AI supply chain and agent security.

Gartner published its inaugural Magic Quadrant for Software Supply Chain Security on 17-18 Jun 2026. Verified Leaders: Black Duck, Checkmarx, Chainguard, Cycode, JFrog, Sonatype. Verified Visionaries: Endor Labs, Lineaje, ReversingLabs. Snyk, Mend, GitHub, GitLab, FOSSA, Anchore, Cybeats positions not confirmed from public sources.

SBOM management is converging with ASPM and artefact repositories (JFrog AppTrust/Evidence, Sonatype Nexus One), while quality scoring (sbomqs) and supplier intake portals become the differentiators for CRA and FDA use cases.

category_notes.recommendation_for_team: Standardise on CycloneDX 1.6/1.7 plus ML-BOM as the house format, run Dependency-Track internally, and position Sonatype or JFrog for clients with existing repositories and Black Duck for embedded/CRA clients. For AI BOM, treat Snyk aibom or cdxgen output as the inventory baseline, add a model file scanner (Prisma AIRS/HiddenLayer/ModelScan) and a runtime or agent discovery layer (Noma/Oligo/Endor MCP governance) since no single tool covers models, datasets, prompts, agents and MCP servers with standards output today.
